offers_products.reason: Cloud HCM software platform (SaaS) covering HR, payroll, spend management and IT asset management is the core offering.

offers_services.reason: Payroll processing, tax filing and benefits administration are run for clients, with implementation and support alongside the software.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Buyers are employers, HR leaders and IT teams; employees only use the tools the employer chooses.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells HCM and payroll software to businesses, franchises, associations and brokers.

recurring_revenue.reason: Subscription SaaS with per-employee payroll runs each pay period gives ongoing recurring revenue.

cyclical_demand.reason: Payroll and HR compliance are essential, so customers rarely cut them, though revenue tracks client headcount.

big_ticket.reason: Small recurring subscription and per-employee fees, not large infrequent purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay mainly for the software platform and automation, not for staff time.

large_customers.reason: Focus is small and mid-sized businesses, from local boutiques to franchises, rather than large enterprises.

asset_heavy.reason: Cloud software business that needs development and staff, not plants, fleets or properties.
